source.citation: Parrott, L. J., Killoh, D. C. (1984). Prediction of cement hydration. British Ceramic Proceedings 35, 41-53.

transcription.note: These are the parameters of the deprecated 'smoothed' variant of the model, used by parrot_killoh. Their provenance is unestablished: the package attributes the rate constants, exponents and B to Parrott and Killoh (1984) and the activation energies to Schindler and Folliard (2005), and neither attribution was verified. The canonical parameters are those of Table 3 of Lavergne et al. (2018), in data/literature/Lavergne2018.json.

T_ref.description: Reference temperature of the smoothed variant.
